fix(engine): yield during guarded merge-worktree removal

LynCo-Patch: F22
Source: 795f80012036d4ed53533cf2378d2c20195a2b8f

Use asynchronous filesystem removal inside the existing guarded retry helper, both before merging and in the maintenance sweep. Await completion; retain path, age, registration and liveness decisions. No background cleanup service or additional timeout.

Tests on pinned upstream d9411c95: 3 responsiveness failures, 49 passing neighboring cases. Same focused suites with the patch: all 52 pass on Linux/Node 22.16.0. This demonstrates the cleanup mechanism, not the cause of every historical HTTP stall.

Delete-when: unpatched upstream yields at both removal boundaries and retains the guarded cleanup regressions.

remove_sections.start: it("reports the original merge failure before asynchronous cleanup settles"
